title: Omarion Hampton: Mike McDaniel will be "super good" for Chargers RBs

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Omarion Hampton: Mike McDaniel will be "super good" for Chargers RBs
sources.description: Chargers quarterback Justin Herbert's bid to change his footwork to better fit into offensive coordinator Mike McDaniel's scheme has been of note this offseason, but McDaniel's arrival effects more than just the quarterback.
